contract.idempotent_registration: Registering an already registered callback returns True without adding a duplicate listener
contract.single_delivery: A listener registered multiple times is delivered the current event only once
contract.delivery_order: Duplicate registration does not alter existing listener order
contract.registry_stability: Duplicate registration does not change registry structure or size
contract.mid_emit_idempotency: Repeated registration during emit remains idempotent
contract.permission_enforcement: Duplicate registration continues to require the events permission
